# Get Location Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given location.

## Syntax

~~~~text
locationDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, location: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
locationDetail(detail: Street, location: home)
~~~~
